notes.title: 🎃 Trick or treat: Welcome to the Escape from Naraka Halloween Update! 🎃
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/a47bc502fdf0c1fa4fb64fd0e3c31be5b8ce33a4.jpg

Spooky greetings, escapees!

It's that time of the year again - it's trick or treat time! Jack-o’-lantern is grinning everywhere, scary and beautiful costumes lurking around every corner and there is the annually Steam Halloween Sale of course!

And that's why Escape from Naraka is currently not only available with a 25% discount, Jack has also gotten lost in the hellish depths of Naraka and teamed up with Rangda the Leyak Queen! Descend into the nightmarish temple and try to save your beloved one - if you dare. But don't turn around, because Jack is already breathing down your neck...

Have a spooky Halloween everyone!
Fathur, Yosua & Irfan - The Xelo Games Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390670/Escape_from_Naraka/

notes.title: February Dev Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38810689/9ceed78d33091a144bdcd7e921099fd8a46cfac6.png
Hi! Escapers! This is what we are working in last month to improving Escape from Naraka!
[olist]
Lighting Improvements
Add key mapping options
Add audio volumes options
Add invert mouse option
Default button for dash is now right mouse button (prev: F)
Default button for interact is now E (prev: left mouse button)
"Load Checkpoint" button is now auto focused in the death screen so that the player can simply press 'SPACE' or 'ENTER' to automatically load the last checkpoint
Add stage timer in HUD, it is by default turned off and can be turned on in the options menu
Add artifact counter in HUD that is shown only when players get an artifact (similar to how the coin counter is shown)
Sync hand movement to footstep sound
Crouch footstep sound is now significantly more frequent
[/olist]
Stay tuned for more Info and Update!
